system.summary: A French syllabic nomenclator mixes numbers and graphic signs for letters, syllables and names, with bars and strokes distinguishing values.

diacritics.note: Bars, cross-strokes and name-code ticks; qF foot bar distinct from qT through-stroke.

system.sibling_key: 11 May scans 50-51 and 28 May scans 62-63 interlinear decipherments; 30 April list A on scan 46.
system.notes: distinct_symbols is the 25 May token alphabet, not a complete historical key. Alternative values may reflect unresolved glyph distinctions. 3 name codes unestablished across both targets; 20^ is an additional inferred syllable.

prior_solution.where: No 25 May or 2 June decipherment found in supplied edition research; bounded search, not proof of universal absence. Sibling decipherments were used.

conditions.human_role: Decipherment contributed by Feyseel Nur with Claude and Codex. Supplied research and visual corrections packaged offline; exact original division of transcription work not documented.

solution.what: Supplied prior_art.txt excludes target from Haak GS 80 and Van Deventer; Veenendaal omitted correspondence; DECODE inconclusive.
11 and 28 May glossed letters transcribed; 30 April token transcription recorded before list A opened. Exact original chronology not independently audited.
Key rebuilt from 11 and 28 May interlinear glosses; alternative values and glyph ambiguities retained.
Key applied to 25 May and 2 June; contextual name guesses kept separate.
List A alignment: 281/330 with alternatives, 270/330 fixed top values; old H band 252/274.
2,000 shuffles and 2,000 key permutations; word coverage 0.838 versus 0.395/0.401 means.
Initial Codex review: confirmed but overstated; notation and holdout limitations identified.

Supplied corrections distinguish qF=po from qT=qui and correct target to plain 42; list A supplies two qF attestations and a third 42. Codex recount: 59/61 once, 58/61 twice; no longer a clean holdout.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: Key rebuilt from adjacent interlinear plaintext on the 11 and 28 May sibling letters and list A on scan 46 in the same archival file, then applied to undeciphered 25 May and 2 June passages.
outcome.fraction_read_source: scripts/measure.py over transcription/25may1601.md and 2jun1601.md: 59/61 + 9/11 = 68/72, excluding context-only I values and unassigned tokens. scripts/attest.py independently recounts 59/61 and 58/61 with >=2 attestations for 25 May.

gaps.detail: Essex is context only, grade I; excluded from supported coverage.
ba and Bruxelles are contextual guesses, grade I.

outcome.notes: One unassigned token (47') is outside grade counts; grades total 71 of 72 positions. 25 May meets the bar, 2 June does not: combined extent partial. Coverage conditional on supplied glyph corrections, not proven accuracy; list A is now attestation, not a clean holdout. Shuffling controls test linguistic structure, not a synthetic solver recovery.
